text:
sofia: FYI opened a PR to add Peru (pe-1) and a small residency FAQ tweak. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/762
marc: Can you paste the exact sentence you added for embeddings storage?
sofia: Draft in PR:
```
Peru (pe-1): Supported. Dedicated and Private deployments: in-region embeddings storage available upon request (subject to contract). Hosted plans: embeddings may be stored outside the country depending on plan tier; contact support for options.
```
elaine: Legal: please remove any "logs" language and use "data processing" phrasing. Also prefer "available upon request" not "on request". Suggest final text: "Data processing options available upon request for Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted plans may store embeddings outside the country depending on tier; contact support for options (subject to contract)."
marc: Thanks. SDK snippets need updates — current examples still use us-east-1. I'll add Rust + Python examples with the canonical header and a migration note about deprecated headers.
marc: Proposed snippets:
```
# curl
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: pe-1" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-emb-1","input":"texto"}'

# python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=TOKEN, region="pe-1")
client.embeddings("hola")

# rust (reqwest)
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let resp = client.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings")
  .header("Authorization", format!("Bearer {}", token))
  .header("X-Redwood-Region", "pe-1")
  .json(&serde_json::json!({"model":"rwd-emb-1","input":"hola"}))
  .send()
  .await?;
```
marc: Migration note to include: "Deprecated headers: 'geo' and 'X-Region-Old' were deprecated 2025-01-15. Clients should migrate to 'X-Redwood-Region'. See /docs/migrate-headers."
support-bot: Support asks for an FAQ blurb: "Are embeddings stored in-country?" Short answer: "Yes for Dedicated/Private when requested; Hosted depends on tier." Point to /residency/overview for more.
sofia: I'll apply legal wording, swap the migrate link to /docs/migrate-headers (we consolidated last sprint), add i18n-needed label (ES/PT), and run link-check locally before pushing.
legal: Approved final phrasing. Please avoid implementation details in public docs.
docs-bot: CI checks passed for PR #762 — link-check staged. Ready to merge after i18n label and copy pass.
sofia: tagging @localization for translation scheduling. Thanks all! :sparkles:
